lines.en: now whenever you walk into a room all everyone will think about is how perfect your face is and they will ignore the rest of you it’s just like what you want isn’t that awesome i think it is

lines.en: scene nods1
I tap on Nodoka’s name in my phone and think about blowing my brains out.
lines.zh: 我戳了戳手机里 Nodoka 的名字，同时思考着要不要一枪崩了自己。

lines.en: : Rain King.
lines.zh: : 雨王。

lines.en: : When do you think we’ll be able to go home today?
lines.zh: : 你觉得今天咱们什么时候能回家？

lines.en: : Not until the well runs dry.
lines.zh: : 直到井水枯竭为止。

lines.en: : You know what they say about leaving before we’re supposed to.
lines.zh: : 关于提前离席会怎样，他们说过的话你也是知道的。

lines.en: : Do I?
lines.zh: : 我知道吗？

lines.en: : I hope so. That’s the only reason we know each other.
lines.zh: : 希望你知道。那可是我们相识的唯一缘由。

lines.en: : I can remember that at least. But I still don’t get why we always have to close our eyes.
lines.zh: : 这点我至少还记得。可我还是不明白为什么我们非得闭上眼睛。

lines.en: : What do you think they do while we can’t see each other?
lines.zh: : 你觉得我们看不见彼此的时候，他们会做些什么？

lines.en: : I can always see you. Even when I close my eyes.
lines.zh: : 我随时都能看见你。就算我闭上眼睛也一样。

lines.en: : Really?
lines.zh: : 真的？

lines.en: : There’s a computer monitor in my childhood home. It never turns off.
lines.zh: : 我小时候的家里有一台电脑显示器。它从不关掉。

lines.en: : She insists on keeping her eyes glued to it in a way that only someone with alogia could. You’d feel terrible to see her.
lines.zh: : 她执意要把眼睛死死黏在上面，那副样子只有患了失语症的人才做得出。你要是见了她，准会难受。

lines.en: : I bet she’s beautiful, though — if she has anything to do with you.
lines.zh: : 不过我敢说她一定很美——只要她跟你有半点关系。

lines.en: : I’ve seen pieces of her scalp come off with the brush before. It’s such a sad thing. She can barely even eat, that old dame.
lines.zh: : 我曾见过她梳头时一块块头皮跟着梳子掉下来。真是凄惨。她连饭都快吃不下了，那个老妇人。

lines.en: : Is it still growing?
lines.zh: : 它还在长吗？

lines.en: : It shrinks. Day by day. Her hair is turning gray. Yet all I can do is pray I don’t end up that way.
lines.zh: : 它在缩。一天比一天少。她的头发正在变白。而我所能做的，只有祈祷自己别落得那般下场。

lines.en: : I’ve been thinking about buying Perfect Face Boy.
lines.zh: : 我在考虑买一个完美脸男孩。

lines.en: : For who?
lines.zh: : 给谁买？

lines.en: : For me.
lines.zh: : 给我自己。

lines.en: : Why?
lines.zh: : 为什么？

lines.en: : You don’t have to do that.
lines.zh: : 你不必那样做的。

lines.en: : My mom said it might make me better.
lines.zh: : 我妈说它可能会让我变得更好。

lines.en: : You’re already as good as you can be.
lines.zh: : 你已经好到不能再好了。

lines.en: : It isn’t enough.
lines.zh: : 这还不够。

lines.en: : It’s enough for me.
lines.zh: : 对我来说够了。

lines.en: : Say...
lines.zh: : 话说……

lines.en: : If I ever break, will you be the one to look after me?
lines.zh: : 如果有一天我坏掉了，你会是那个照顾我的人吗？

lines.en: : Me?
: I can think of no one better to comb the scalp out of my hair.
lines.zh: : 我想不出还有谁比您更适合把头皮从我头发里梳掉。

lines.en: : Of course, Nodoka.
lines.zh: : 当然会，Nodoka。

lines.en: scene black
: Anything for my little sister.
lines.zh: : 为了我的小妹妹，什么都行。

lines.en: scene nods2
scene mall2
I tap on my left hand instead of my phone and it activates phonebeep.wav anyway because nothing is real.
lines.zh: 我戳的是自己的左手而不是手机，可它照样触发了 phonebeep.wav，因为一切都是假的。

lines.en: show chikachappy
: Sensei! Hi! What are you doing here?
lines.zh: : 老师！嗨！您在这儿干什么呢？

lines.en: : Hi, outdated Chika sprite. I'm trying to contact Nodoka.
lines.zh: : 你好啊，过时的 Chika 立绘。我在试着联系 Nodoka。

lines.en: : How did we even get inside of the mall? Isn’t it supposed to be closed for renovations?
lines.zh: : 我们到底是怎么进到商场里来的？这里不是应该在装修停业吗？

lines.en: : Not that I know of. But I’m Chika from the past. You know! Like, before you took advantage of my desire for love and stability and let me think we were a couple for years.
lines.zh: : 据我所知没有。不过我是来自过去的 Chika。你懂的！就是你利用我对爱与安稳的渴望、让我以为我们是一对了好几年——在那之前那个我。

lines.en: : How does Chika from the past have knowledge of the present?
lines.zh: : 来自过去的 Chika 怎么会知道现在的事？

lines.en: scene nods3
: STOP ASKING STUPID QUESTIONS!
lines.zh: : 别再问蠢问题了！

lines.en: scene mall2
show chikachappy
: Anyway, if you came here for Perfect Face Boy, we’re all sold out. Some girl with a flower in her hair just bought the last one. Something about “market research” I think?
lines.zh: : 话说回来，如果您是来买完美脸男孩的，我们已经全卖光了。刚才有个头发上别着花的女孩把最后一个买走了。好像说了什么「市场调研」来着？

lines.en: : Damn. I’m going to have to figure out a different birthday present for Nodoka, then.
lines.zh: : 靠。那我得给 Nodoka 想个别样的生日礼物了。

lines.en: show chikacsurprised
: Who’s this Nodoka girl you keep talking about? Is she from Ms. Matsubara’s class?
lines.zh: : 您一直念叨的这个 Nodoka 是谁呀？是松原老师班上的吗？

lines.en: : Who?
: Oh. Sorry. Who’s this Nodoka girl you keep talking about? Is she from Ms. Watabe’s class?
lines.zh: : 哦。抱歉。您一直念叨的这个 Nodoka 是谁呀？是渡部老师班上的吗？

lines.en: : No, she’s from that other school that hasn’t sunken into the ground yet. She’s a bit of an enigma, but I think her heart is in the right place most of the time.
lines.zh: : 不是，她来自另一所还没沉到地底下去的学校。她有点难以捉摸，不过我觉得大多数时候她的心眼还是正的。

lines.en: : Where is it the rest of the time?
lines.zh: : 那其余时间她的心在哪儿？

lines.en: : Probably Ami’s underwear drawer. Where would you hide human remains, Chika?
lines.zh: : 大概在 Ami 的内衣抽屉里。换作是你，会把人体残骸藏在哪儿呢，Chika？

lines.en: show chikacveryhappy
: Hahah! Wouldn’t you like to know?
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈哈！您不想知道吗？

lines.en: show chikachappy
: Anyway! I’ve gotta run, Sensei. My break is almost over.
lines.zh: : 总之！我得走了，老师。我的休息时间快结束了。

lines.en: : But if you ever feel like luring someone into a false sense of romantic security before entirely shattering their world view by fucking all of their friends, feel free to drop by again!
lines.zh: : 不过要是您哪天又想先用虚假的恋爱安全感把人骗住，再把她所有朋友都睡一遍来彻底粉碎她的世界观，随时欢迎再来！

lines.en: : Thanks, Chika. I think I will. Good luck with Perfect Face Boy.
lines.zh: : 谢了，Chika。我想我会的。祝你卖完美脸男孩顺利。

lines.en: : Thanks, Sensei! Good luck with contacting that Nodoka girl!
lines.zh: : 谢谢老师！祝您顺利联系上那个叫 Nodoka 的女孩！

lines.en: scene black
I manage to leave the mall through a meat-filled crack in the wall before returning home for a quick change of clothes and starting over.
lines.zh: 我设法从墙上一道塞满肉的裂缝里离开了商场，然后回家匆匆换了身衣服，重新开始。

lines.en: scene bedroom_noon
I tap on Nodoka’s name in my phone and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我戳下手机里 Nodoka 的名字，等她接听。

lines.en: : Ahem.
lines.zh: : 咳咳。

lines.en: : I would like to sleep like a cat.
lines.zh: : 我想像猫一样睡上一觉。

lines.en: : What? Like, now? Did I wake you up?
lines.zh: : 什么？就现在吗？我把你吵醒了？

lines.en: : With all the fur of time...and a tongue rough as flint.
lines.zh: : 披着时间全部的皮毛……舌糙如燧石。

lines.en: : With the dry sex of fire...and after speaking to no one, stretch myself over the world. Over roofs and landscapes...with a passionate desire to hunt the rats in my dreams.
lines.zh: : 带着火干燥的性……不与任何人交谈之后，把我自己铺展在世界之上。越过屋顶与风景……怀着猎捕梦中鼠辈的热望。

lines.en: : Well, I’m glad to hear you’re doing fine.
lines.zh: : 好吧，听你这么精神我就放心了。

lines.en: : And I’m surprised to hear you didn’t recognize that poem, Akira. Not a fan of Chilean diplomats?
lines.zh: : 倒是您没听出那首诗，让我有些意外，Akira。您不喜欢智利外交官吗？

lines.en: : Yeah, can’t say that’s a major area of expertise for me. What are you up to right now? Besides being weird, I mean.
lines.zh: : 是啊，这可不是我的专长领域。你现在在忙什么？除了发神经以外，我是说。

lines.en: : A bit of this...a bit of that. All in an effort to make the world a better place, of course.
lines.zh: : 一点这个……一点那个。当然，一切都是为了让世界变得更美好。

lines.en: : Well, how about putting that on hold and coming over to my place for a little while?
lines.zh: : 那能不能先放一放，来我家待一会儿？

lines.en: : Oh?
: So long as you promise not to coax me into a state of unconsciousness via sex again.
lines.zh: : 只要你保证不再用性事把我哄到失去意识就行。

lines.en: : Aww...But I took such good care of you while you were out.
lines.zh: : 哎呀……可您昏过去的时候，我把您照顾得多好啊。

lines.en: : That doesn’t change the fact that it was kind of weird and creepy.
lines.zh: : 这改变不了那件事又怪又瘆人的事实。

lines.en: : Then, how about I make it up to you by letting you bed me the next time I slip into a state of unconsciousness?
lines.zh: : 那么，下次换我陷入无意识状态的时候，让您把我弄上床，当作赔罪如何？

lines.en: : Or we could just have normal, conscious sex together. That works too.
lines.zh: : 或者我们也可以就这样正常地、清醒着做爱。那样也行啊。

lines.en: : Does it?
lines.zh: : 是吗？

lines.en: : Does...Does that just not do it for you? Or...
lines.zh: : 难……难道那样你提不起兴致？还是说……

lines.en: : It just sounds to me that this is a...recreational booty call, rather than the type I’ve grown accustomed to from you.
lines.zh: : 在我听来，这更像是一次……消遣性的约炮，而不是我已经习惯从您这儿得到的那种。

lines.en: if beachwars17 == True:
: What about that time I summoned you for an encounter with the proprietor of a local cafe?
lines.zh: : 那次我叫你来跟本地咖啡馆的老板娘碰面呢？

lines.en: : What about it?
lines.zh: : 那次怎么了？

lines.en: : Well, that was recreational, wasn’t it?
lines.zh: : 那个总该算消遣吧？

lines.en: : Was it?
lines.zh: : 是吗？

lines.en: : Are you coming or not? I can also come to you if-
lines.zh: : 你到底来不来？不然我也可以去你那儿——

lines.en: : I’ll be there shortly, Akira. I’ve already hailed a cab.
lines.zh: : 我很快就到，Akira。我已经叫了出租车。

lines.en: : Now, please describe in vivid detail the things you plan on doing to me as I place you on speaker from the backseat of this car.
lines.zh: : 现在，请绘声绘色地描述一下您打算对我做的事吧，我要在这辆车的后座上把您开成免提。

lines.en: : I hope you’re ready to study, because that’s all we’re going to be doing today.
lines.zh: : 希望你做好学习的准备，因为我们今天只干这个。

lines.en: : Heh...
: I’ll see you soon.
lines.zh: : 我们很快见。

lines.en: scene black
scene nods4
Nodoka arrives about ten minutes later, prompting me to question why more people don’t just take taxis after I invite them over.
lines.zh: 大约十分钟后 Nodoka 就到了，这让我不禁怀疑，为什么我约过来的人里没几个愿意直接打车。

lines.en: That question is quickly answered when I remember the type of crowd I typically invite over and how they likely don’t have much pocket money.
lines.zh: 这个问题很快有了答案——我想起自己平时叫来的都是些什么人，而她们多半没什么零花钱。

lines.en: Now, relatively famous authors, on the other hand...
lines.zh: 不过嘛，相对有名的作家就另当别论了……

lines.en: : I have to say...I’m quite intrigued by whatever is going on here, Akira. I didn’t believe I was on the list of girls you were willing to see casually.
lines.zh: : 我得说……这里发生的一切让我相当好奇，Akira。我本不认为自己在您愿意随意见面的女孩名单上。

lines.en: : You’re going to be even more surprised when you find out I called you over to ask for your hand in marriage.
lines.zh: : 等你知道我叫你来是为了向你求婚，你会更惊讶的。

lines.en: : Ahh, I see. And in lieu of a ring, I presume you’re going to offer up your body instead?
lines.zh: : 啊，我明白了。那么想必您是要以自己的身体代替戒指了？

lines.en: : Would you rather the ring?
lines.zh: : 你更想要戒指？

lines.en: : You can give that to Otoha instead. She can add it to the collection. Your warm embrace is all I care for, Akira.
lines.zh: : 那个您还是给 Otoha 吧。她可以收进收藏里。我在乎的只有您温暖的怀抱，Akira。

lines.en: : Then-
scene nods5
: But first, I have a...surprise for you.
lines.zh: : 不过首先，我有件……惊喜要给您。

lines.en: : What...kind of surprise? You didn’t bring a bag. And I don’t see any-
lines.zh: : 什么……样的惊喜？你没带包啊。而且我也没看到什么——

lines.en: : Perhaps it’s something I have on beneath my clothes? Perhaps it’s an...act of service? Perhaps both. Perhaps neither.
lines.zh: : 也许是我衣服底下穿着的什么东西？也许是某种……服务？也许两者皆是。也许都不是。

lines.en: : The allure is in not knowing. Don’t you want to find out?
lines.zh: : 魅力正在于未知。您不想弄清楚吗？

lines.en: : Unless you want to just have boring old, consensual missionary sex.
lines.zh: : 除非您只想要无聊的、双方自愿的传教士体位。

lines.en: : I actually think that would be really hot with you.
lines.zh: : 说实话我觉得跟你那样反而特别带感。

lines.en: scene nods6
: I suppose it would, wouldn’t it? It’d be very uncharacteristic without one of us forcing the other into a state of delirium.
lines.zh: : 大概是吧，不是吗？如果没有一方把另一方弄到神志不清，反而不像我们的风格。

lines.en: scene black
: Yeah. But I don’t get to experience “surprises” very often, so I’ll go along with it this time.
lines.zh: : 是。不过我很少能体验到「惊喜」，所以这次就陪你玩玩。

lines.en: : Just so you’re aware, though, we will be having consensual missionary sex the next time you come over. Whether you like it or not.
lines.zh: : 不过你心里有个数，下次你来的时候，我们一定会做一次双方自愿的传教士体位。不管你愿不愿意。

lines.en: : Ahh, yes. Spoken just like a man who doesn’t know the meaning of the word “consent.” This is why I keep you so close to my heart, Akira.
lines.zh: : 啊，是啊。说这话的口气，活像个根本不懂「同意」二字含义的男人。正是因此我才把您贴在心口这么近，Akira。

lines.en: : Wait, why do you sound so far away all of a sudden?
lines.zh: : 等等，你的声音怎么突然变得这么远？

lines.en: : Hm? You’ll have to speak up. I can’t hear you from your daughter’s room.
lines.zh: : 嗯？您得大声点。我在您女儿的房间里，听不清。

lines.en: scene nods7
: What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : Wow. It’s quite...feminine in here, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 哇。这里面还真是……很有女孩子气呢，不是吗？

lines.en: scene nods8
: Nodoka — I’d really prefer it if you don’t go exploring inside of Ami’s room. Especially if you’re going to lock me out of it.
lines.zh: : Nodoka——我真的希望你别在 Ami 的房间里乱翻。尤其是你还要把我锁在外面。

lines.en: : Why is that, Akira? There’s not something you’re trying to hide from me in here, is there?
lines.zh: : 那是为什么呢，Akira？这房间里没有什么您想瞒着我的东西吧？

lines.en: : What? No. It’s just weird and Ami has been particularly creepy lately. I wouldn’t want her coming home and-
lines.zh: : 什么？没有。就是很奇怪，而且 Ami 最近格外瘆人。我不想她回到家然后——

lines.en: : Hurting me? A cute little thing like her? Do you think she could manage it?
lines.zh: : 然后伤了我吗？像她那么可爱的小东西？您觉得她做得到吗？

lines.en: : I’m thinking a lot of things right now. And almost all of them have to do with the fact that you came over and immediately tricked me into closing my eyes so you could invade Ami’s privacy.
lines.zh: : 我现在脑子里想的事情可多了。而几乎每一件都跟这个事实有关——你一进门就骗我闭上眼睛，好让你侵犯 Ami 的隐私。

lines.en: scene nods9
: But I’m doing this for you. This is the surprise I was talking about. You just need to let me prepare first.
lines.zh: : 可我这是为了您啊。这就是我说的惊喜。您只需要先让我准备一下。

lines.en: : Prepare what? Because that implies some level of intent and I highly doubt you’ve been plotting this out for longer than five minutes total.
lines.zh: : 准备什么？这说法意味着某种预谋，而我非常怀疑你总共策划了超过五分钟。

lines.en: : And why would you think that?
lines.zh: : 您为什么会这么想呢？

lines.en: : Because if you’d been plotting it any longer, you’d have accomplished it already.
lines.zh: : 因为要是你真策划那么久，早就得手了。

lines.en: scene nods10
: Heh. You give me too much credit.
lines.zh: : 呵。您太高看我了。

lines.en: : Sometimes, I really am just a curious little girl.
lines.zh: : 有时候，我真的只是个好奇的小女孩罢了。

lines.en: scene nods11
: And who is better at showing “curious little girls” the...ins and outs of life than their daddy?
lines.zh: : 而说到给「好奇的小女孩」讲解人生的……进进出出，还有谁比她们的爸爸更合适呢？

lines.en: : I’m beginning to think this isn’t for me at all.
lines.zh: : 我开始觉得这根本不是为了我。

lines.en: : It’s for both of us, Akira. But only one of us is willing to openly admit it.
lines.zh: : 这是为了我们两个，Akira。只是我们之中只有一个愿意坦白承认。

lines.en: : Nodoka-
lines.zh: : Nodoka——

lines.en: : Just be patient. I’ll unlock the door in a moment.
lines.zh: : 耐心点。我待会儿就把门打开。

lines.en: scene black
: But when I do...please don’t assault me immediately.
lines.zh: : 不过等我开门的时候……请别立刻就扑上来。

lines.en: : It may take me a moment or two to...get fully in character.
lines.zh: : 我可能得花上一点时间才能……完全进入角色。

lines.en: I keep my ear pressed against the door, listening to Nodoka rummage through Ami’s closet and drawers and...anything else she can get her hands on, I imagine.
lines.zh: 我把耳朵贴在门上，听着 Nodoka 翻找 Ami 的衣柜、抽屉，还有……我想，任何她够得着的东西。

lines.en: And while my initial instinct is to break the door down, I’m a bit reluctant to do that as it would be much harder to explain away than just...some of Ami’s belongings being shifted around.
lines.zh: 虽然我的第一反应是把门踹开，但我有些犹豫——比起单纯……Ami 的东西被挪动过位置，破门而入要难解释得多。

lines.en: If she wants to play games, that’s fine. She can mess with me all she wants. But dragging my daughter into her nonsense just to satisfy her curiosity isn’t...something I can let happen anymore.
lines.zh: 她想玩游戏，随她。她爱怎么折腾我都行。但为了一己的好奇心把我女儿也拖进她的胡闹里，这……我不能再任其发生了。

lines.en: I promised to really protect Ami when I decided to take up the title of “father.” And knowing Nodoka’s history, it’s...hard for me to imagine she doesn’t have some sort of ulterior motive to what she’s doing right now.
lines.zh: 在我决定担起「父亲」这个名号的时候，我答应过要真正保护 Ami。而以 Nodoka 的既往记录来看……我很难想象她此刻的所作所为会没有某种不可告人的动机。

lines.en: : Okay...that should do it.
lines.zh: : 好了……这样应该就行了。

lines.en: : You may enter, Akira. But again, please do not assault me as soon as you-
lines.zh: : 您可以进来了，Akira。不过再说一次，请不要一看到我就扑上来——

lines.en: scene nods12
: Welcome home, Dad! I’ve been waiting for you all day!
lines.zh: : 欢迎回家，爸爸！我等了您一整天了！

lines.en: scene nods13
: And now that you’re here, it means we get to cuddle and watch movies and cuddle and eat ice cream and cuddle and-
lines.zh: : 既然您回来了，就意味着我们可以抱抱、看电影、抱抱、吃冰淇淋、抱抱，还有——

lines.en: : What...
lines.zh: : 什么……

lines.en: : The fuck...
lines.zh: : 他妈的……

lines.en: : Do you think you’re doing?...
lines.zh: : 你以为你在干什么？……

lines.en: scene nods14
: Cosplay! Aren’t I adorable, Dad?
lines.zh: : 角色扮演！我可爱吗，爸爸？

lines.en: : Take her clothes off. Now.
lines.zh: : 把她的衣服脱下来。现在。

lines.en: scene nods15
: You want to touch your little girl that badly? Was it hard being away from me all day?
lines.zh: : 您就这么想摸您的小女儿吗？一整天没见我，是不是很难熬？

lines.en: scene nods16
: How about we get in the bath together and I wash your back?! And anything else that needs washing! Maybe your penis? With my mouth? That sounds fun, right?
lines.zh: : 要不我们一起泡澡，我给您搓背？！还有别的需要洗的地方也行！比如说您的鸡巴？用我的嘴？听起来很有趣吧？
: 为什么？……

lines.en: : Because I love you, of course!
lines.zh: : 当然是因为我爱您啊！

lines.en: : No, Nodoka. Why are you doing this?
lines.zh: : 不，Nodoka。你为什么要做这种事？

lines.en: scene nods17
: Because I love you, of course!
lines.zh: : 当然是因为我爱您啊！

lines.en: scene nods18
: Did that make your heart skip a beat?
lines.zh: : 这有没有让您心跳漏了一拍？

lines.en: : Is it because I look like her? Because I sound like her? Or am I still obviously me?
lines.zh: : 是因为我长得像她吗？因为我说话像她吗？还是说我分明就还是我自己？

lines.en: : You’re...better at impersonating her than you should be. But she isn’t exactly hard to mimic. Like, even the hair is-
lines.zh: : 你……模仿她模仿得好得过分了。不过她本来也不难学。比如说，连头发都——

lines.en: : Spot-on, right?
lines.zh: : 一模一样，对吧？

lines.en: : And to think I barely even have any acting experience. Can you imagine how effective this ruse would be if I had practice?
lines.zh: : 想想看，我几乎毫无表演经验。要是我练过，这骗术该有多奏效，您能想象吗？

lines.en: : Sure. But I still don’t get why. And just pretending you love me doesn’t answer it.
lines.zh: : 当然。可我还是不明白为什么。光是假装爱我，回答不了这个问题。

lines.en: scene nods19
: Maybe I’m just a super big Ami fan?! Her style...her eyes...her poetry...those cute little A-cups you can’t help but wanna grab and squeeze and make her blush and cum and wet herself!
lines.zh: : 也许我只是 Ami 的超级大粉丝罢了？！她的品味……她的眼睛……她的诗……那可爱的小 A 罩杯，让人忍不住想抓想揉，想让她脸红、想让她潮吹、想让她尿出来！

lines.en: scene nods20
: That wholesome, incestuous desire to be bred by her father because her love is so pure and uninfluenced by the many evils of this universe...
lines.zh: : 那种健康又乱伦的渴望——想被自己的父亲配种，因为她的爱如此纯粹，丝毫不受这宇宙间诸多邪恶的沾染……

lines.en: : Isn’t Ami just the greatest?...
lines.zh: : Ami 难道不是最棒的吗？……

lines.en: : Isn’t she?
lines.zh: : 难道不是吗？

lines.en: : Are you acting again?
lines.zh: : 你又在演戏了？

lines.en: scene nods21
: Of course not, Dad. This is just who I want to be. So I’m making my bestest effort to be the perfect daughter for you. That way, you’ll never need anyone else and can stay with me always.
lines.zh: : 当然不是，爸爸。这就是我想成为的样子。所以我在拼尽全力做您完美的女儿。这样一来，您就再也不需要别人，可以永远陪着我了。

lines.en: : Are you making fun of her right now?
lines.zh: : 你现在是在取笑她吗？

lines.en: : Does it sound like I’m making fun of her? Is any of what I said untrue? Were some of the words not words Ami would use?
lines.zh: : 我听起来像在取笑她吗？我说的有哪一句不属实吗？有哪个词不是 Ami 会用的词吗？

lines.en: : Nodoka-
lines.zh: : Nodoka——

lines.en: : Those are all serious questions, by the way. I really want to know.
lines.zh: : 顺便说一句，这些都是认真的问题。我真的很想知道。

lines.en: : Then ask her. You don’t have to sneak into her room and put on her clothes if you want to learn more about her. Just talk to her.
lines.zh: : 那就去问她啊。你想多了解她，不必溜进她房间穿上她的衣服。直接跟她聊聊就行。

lines.en: : Assuming any of that is actually true and this isn’t just some sexual fantasy of yours where you can satisfy the need to fuck the father you no longer have.
lines.zh: : 前提是那些话里有半点是真的，而不是你为了满足「再操一次父亲」的欲望编出来的性幻想——那个你已经没有了的父亲。

lines.en: : What makes you think I ever had a father at all and wasn’t just made in a tube?
lines.zh: : 您凭什么认为我本来就有父亲，而不是在一根试管里造出来的呢？

lines.en: : Sometimes, not much.
lines.zh: : 有时候，还真没什么凭据。

lines.en: : Would you still fuck me if I really was your daughter?
lines.zh: : 如果我真的是您的女儿，您还会操我吗？

lines.en: : Nodoka-
lines.zh: : Nodoka——

lines.en: : Do you fuck Ami even though she’s not? Is it even true that she’s not? What’s it like? How does she taste? How different am I? How can I be more like her?
lines.zh: : 您操 Ami 吗，尽管她并不是？她不是您女儿这件事，是真的吗？那是什么感觉？她尝起来什么味道？我跟她差多少？我该怎么样才能更像她？

lines.en: : Is this really for my sake, Nodoka?
lines.zh: : 这真的是为了我吗，Nodoka？

lines.en: : Call me Ami.
lines.zh: : 叫我 Ami。

lines.en: : Absolutely not.
lines.zh: : 绝对不行。

lines.en: : Then how about Nodokami? It combines both of our names and makes me feel like a god. Everyone wins.
lines.zh: : 那 Nodokami 怎么样？把我们的名字合在一起，让我感觉自己像个神。皆大欢喜。

lines.en: : Everyone except the actual Ami, who just had her closet raided by a psychopath who wants to pretend she’s fucking her dad.
lines.zh: : 除了真正的 Ami 之外每个人都赢——她的衣柜刚被一个想假装跟自己爸爸上床的疯子洗劫了。

lines.en: scene nods22
: My intentions aren’t always evil genius levels of malicious, Akira. I figured you’d know that about me by now.
lines.zh: : 我的意图并不总是到邪恶天才那种恶毒程度，Akira。我还以为您到现在总该了解我这一点了。

lines.en: : You figured I’d be happy to have an Ami who isn’t actually Ami?
lines.zh: : 你觉得我会乐意拥有一个不是 Ami 的 Ami？

lines.en: : Yes. Because, the way I see it, if you aren’t already fucking her, this would give you the chance to do it guilt-free.
lines.zh: : 是的。因为在我看来，如果您还没在操她，这就能给您一个毫无负罪感的机会。

lines.en: : And if you are, this could be a fun new flavor of fake incest you can compare and contrast with the real thing.
lines.zh: : 而如果您已经在操她了，这又能添上一味有趣的假乱伦，好让您跟真货对比一番。

lines.en: : But you’re getting something out of it. You wouldn’t do this if you didn’t have something to gain.
lines.zh: : 可你自己也有所图。要是没好处，你不会做这种事。

lines.en: : Sometimes, I just want to understand things.
lines.zh: : 有时候，我只是想弄懂一些事情。

lines.en: : And I have a hard time doing that if the things I want to understand don’t make any sense.
lines.zh: : 而如果我想弄懂的事情本身毫无道理，我就很难办到。

lines.en: : Nodo-
lines.zh: : Nodo——

lines.en: : I had a dream last night...
lines.zh: : 我昨晚做了个梦……

lines.en: scene nods23
: That we were closer than we thought.
lines.zh: : 梦见我们比想象中更亲近。

lines.en: : But there was a dark cloud looming over us. And it wouldn’t let us be what we needed to be in order to be happy.
lines.zh: : 可有一片乌云笼罩在我们头上。它不让我们成为幸福所必需的那种样子。

lines.en: : That cloud was jealous. But it was jealous because it wanted the same thing.
lines.zh: : 那片云在嫉妒。而它之所以嫉妒，是因为它想要同样的东西。

lines.en: : It had been waiting to rain for centuries, but was too afraid to open itself up because it was worried it might flood the world and drown you. Beautiful you.
lines.zh: : 它已经等了几个世纪想要降雨，却不敢敞开自己，因为担心会淹没世界、把你淹死。美丽的你。

lines.en: : Everyone else could be washed away for all it cared. And despite my wanting to lock you inside and protect you...I couldn’t help but feel the need to give you up when I compared myself to that darkness.
lines.zh: : 至于其他所有人，被冲走也跟它无关。而尽管我想把您锁起来保护您……可一拿自己跟那片黑暗相比，我还是忍不住觉得该把您让出去。

lines.en: : But you won’t ever be that darkness, Nodoka.
lines.zh: : 可你永远不会变成那片黑暗，Nodoka。

lines.en: : No...I suppose I won’t.
lines.zh: : 不……我想不会。

lines.en: scene nods24
: But I can still aspire to understand it. And if I spend long enough inside its mindset, maybe I’ll be able to feel what it feels.
lines.zh: : 但我仍可以勉力去理解它。如果我在它的心境里待得够久，也许就能感受到它所感受的一切。

lines.en: : There is something special about Ami. And I don’t want to wait for the rain anymore. I want to feel it. I want to feel her. I want to feel the way she feels you.
lines.zh: : Ami 身上有某种特别的东西。我不想再等雨落下来了。我想感受它。我想感受她。我想感受她感受你的方式。

lines.en: scene nods25
: It’s but one of many missing pieces in many of my unsolved puzzles...
lines.zh: : 这不过是我许多未解之谜中，许多缺失的碎片之一罢了……

lines.en: : All on the way to perfect hair forever.
lines.zh: : 一切都在通往永远完美的头发。
